instruction:
Create `packages/element/tests/textStyleRanges.test.ts` so that these problems are solved, following the conventions in the shared brief:
1. Unit U16 has not been written in two rounds: the typist timed out once, and the last reply was not one JSON object in the {path, content} contract. Answer with exactly one JSON object {"path": "packages/element/tests/textStyleRanges.test.ts", "content": "<whole file>"} and nothing else. Keep the file compact (about 250 lines, no more than about 20 `it` cases), covering: normalizeStyleRanges (clamp, drop empty, sort, merge adjacent equal styles); applyStyleToRange splitting a range; shift on insert before/inside/after and delete before/overlapping/covering a range; getStyleRunsForLines for wrapped text, a bound-text container width, and a font change that re-wraps; undo/redo of a styleRanges change via ElementsDelta. ElementsDelta has no hasVisibleDifferences: use `ElementsDelta.calculate(before, after)`, `delta.isEmpty()`, `delta.inverse()`, `delta.applyTo(current, snapshot)` returning `[elementsMap, isVisible]`, and `delta.updated[elementId]`, with SceneElementsMap built via arrayToMap (see packages/element/tests/delta.test.tsx). For an equal-content styleRanges change assert `delta.isEmpty()` is true. Create text elements with newTextElement({ text, styleRanges, ... }) from @excalidraw/element (API.createElement drops styleRanges).
Return JSON {path, content} with the complete file.
